text: ここから　だと　４のしまに　とんで　いけるぞ

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after だ or a verb means 'if' or 'when' that is so, then the next thing follows. ここから　だと = 'if it's from here'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus いく says you go somewhere by doing that action. とんで　いける = 'can go by flying'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いける means 'can go'. いける = 'can go'.
